segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to effect a business combination with one or more target businesses; has no operations or revenue.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check exempted company incorporated in the Cayman Islands on September 5, 2025, and formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses (a "Business Combination").
